#[must_use]
pub const fn is_bridged(provider: UpstreamProvider) -> bool {
    matches!(
        provider,
        UpstreamProvider::Codex
            | UpstreamProvider::Qwen
            | UpstreamProvider::Gemini
            | UpstreamProvider::OpenAICompatible
            | UpstreamProvider::ZaiCodingPlan
    )
}
